responsibility: This header assembles the lang_hooks macro definitions shared by the C and Objective-C front ends. It maps generic GCC hook slots to C-family implementations for option handling, diagnostics, declaration finishing, builtins, alias analysis, gimplification, OpenMP clause support, type utilities, and early debug emission, leaving only language-specific hook overrides to c-lang.cc or objc-lang.cc.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the lang_hooks wiring header for the shared C/Objective-C layer, consisting mainly of LANG_HOOKS macro definitions selecting common implementations; gcc/c/c-objc-common.cc is the companion implementation file that defines the shared hook functions and diagnostic helpers those macros reference.
